page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Greek lead-ins sit inline at the start of paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: Epodus 2. versuum 14.
main_text.p: APerit fontem orationis in Apolline cur ista dixerit: deinde ad alterum, quod de parentibus Cyrenes quesiuerat.

Καὶ γὰρ σε.) Expositurus prudes vates Chiron, unde compulsus Apollo in haec verba prorupit, blandè orationem praemollit, nemo te medacio inuoluere potest. itaque scio cur haec dixeris, amore flagrans pectus erga puellam te cogit.

Κύρης δ' ὁπόθεν[?].) Ad alterum respondet, quod de parentibus quaesierat ἄνα[?] ab ἄναξ[?] vocat. est ô Rex, Laudes Aploli-nis luculenter perstrinxit, id est, finem rerum tenes. 2.numerum etiam rerum omnium, scis etiam homini impossibilia, ut arenae numerus quis sit: futuros euentus ad amussim iam ante scis.
Εἰδήσεχρή[?].) Praemollit vaticinium suum de sobole nascitura ex Cyrene, quum apud Deum & de Deo id sit habiturus.
main_text.head: Strophe 3. versuum 15.
main_text.p: RAptum suadet ac vaticinatur quomodo in Libyam deportanda, urbsque ex eius nomine condenda: Græ-ci insulares isthuc colligedi, locique illius fore dominam.
Ἐρέω.ταῦτα πωσίς[?].) Primum honesta dicendi formula con-gressum suadet.

Καὶ μέλλεις.) Oraculum de Cyrene in Libyam transferenda. Διὸς κῆπος Iouis hortus, forsan propter Ammonium Iouem: vel quia Ægypto vicina sit, quæ Iouis τέμενος[?] dicta fuit. Iupiter Libycus cultus fuit a multis: unde illud Festi, qui Macedonica conscripsit.

Ἐν Θεύνιν ἀρχέπολιν[?].) De urbe extruenda in Libya ex nomine Cyrenes, vide supra 4. hymno. ἀρχέπολις dicitur primaria urbs, metropolis totius regni: & nunc datiuo, reddes ei, Cyrenæ condes eam urbem.

Ἐπὶ λαὸν.) Aliud vaticinium de Græcis insularibus isthuc congregandis: id factum est per Battum, qui ex Thera insula, Callista prius dicta eos in Libyam deduxit oraculo Apollinis, uti supra 4. Ode vidimus..

page.notes: Greek lead-ins and Greek verse are doubtful in several places and are marked [?]: the accents and letters of "Κύρης δ' ὁπόθεν", "ἄνα ab ἄναξ", "Εἰδήσεχρή", "Ἐρέω.ταῦτα πωσίς", "τέμενος" and "Ἐν Θεύνιν ἀρχέπολιν". The catchword "Νῦν" is also uncertain. Long s is printed as f in places and has been read as s (for example "sobole", "suadet", "scis", "potest", "amussim"). The printed "Aploli-nis" is kept as printed, with its hyphen. The drop capitals A and R are joined to their words. The double full stop after "vidimus" is printed as it stands.
